tools.name: smartrecruiters_search_jobs
tools.description: Search the company's job requisitions by keyword, status, city, department or update time. Returns content with each job, totalFound and nextPageId. SmartRecruiters: GET /jobs.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_get_job
tools.description: Get one job requisition by id: title, status, location, department and hiring team. SmartRecruiters: GET /jobs/{jobId}.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_search_candidates
tools.description: Search candidates who have at least one job application, by keyword, job, status, tag or update time. Returns content, totalFound and nextPageId. Call one page at a time: this endpoint allows one concurrent request. SmartRecruiters: GET /candidates.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_get_candidate
tools.description: Get one candidate's profile by id: name, contact details, source, tags and properties. SmartRecruiters: GET /candidates/{id}.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_get_candidate_application
tools.description: Get one candidate's application to one job: status, substatus, rating and screening answers. SmartRecruiters: GET /candidates/{id}/jobs/{jobId}.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_list_candidate_attachments
tools.description: List the files attached to a candidate, such as a CV or cover letter (metadata only). SmartRecruiters: GET /candidates/{id}/attachments.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_search_offers
tools.description: Search job offers by status, keyword or posting id. The key must belong to a user with the Extended or Admin system role. SmartRecruiters: GET /offers.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the company, such as recruiters and hiring managers, with name, email and system role. SmartRecruiters: GET /users.

tools.name: smartrecruiters_add_candidate_tags
tools.description: Add tags to one candidate. Existing tags stay; this call never replaces or removes tags. Up to 100 tags, 150 characters each. SmartRecruiters: POST /candidates/{id}/tags.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smartrecruiters_list_users · Private data: smartrecruiters_get_candidate, smartrecruiters_list_candidate_attachments · Public sink: smartrecruiters_list_users, smartrecruiters_add_candidate_tags.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smartrecruiters_list_users · Private data: smartrecruiters_get_candidate, smartrecruiters_list_candidate_attachments · Public sink: smartrecruiters_list_users, smartrecruiters_add_candidate_tags

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
